title: SPTS-JM-BANK-STREAM: native measured-record search with linear classical space

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2N), the ONE SPTS-JM-BANK-STREAM physical implementation in proof.md executes the complete selected SPTS-JM algorithm, using the complete bank source for polynomial phases and the explicit native classical coarse controller for all repeated search attempts. Large logical record arrays remain measured computational-basis quantum cells; current fixed-number n-bit words, persistent gate descriptors and 8-bit-per-level preparation return frames occupy only O(n) physical classical bits. The native fixed-grammar generator emits exactly V_j and its actual adjoint at immutable history prefixes; its measured record reads never depend on a superposed candidate. The full CQ invariant includes unread original systems and arbitrary good/bad/reference entanglement, so output law is exactly the complete virtual program and full-secret success is strictly greater than11/16 under the exact fixed original joint-good-marginal model with at most floor(Q/3) bad positions. All finite n<64 and n=1 branches are unchanged. ALL FIVE guarantees hold JOINTLY on EVERY branch, including failed work, original pre-attempt token guards, full paired allocation/address charges, actual compiler bit work, every read/write and source SWAP, mode transfers, initialization and complete output-first cleanup. No QRAM, quantum-addressed classical bank, source inverse/control, supplied purification or arbitrary rotation primitive is used. Actual charged sequential time is O(2^((1/2)n)n(log2n)^3), exact growth index1. A complete native constraint costs O(nL^3), constant-bit recursion frames give the same C(V_j)<=3C(V_(j-1))+C(j+1)nL^3 recurrence, and native clock/token/verification work fits O(B A_j nL^3) per admitted attempt. The generic descriptor interpreter runs only polynomial-total phases; its overhead is explicitly paid and absorbed.

structured.error_model: Among the Q acquired copies, an adversary fixes a set B of at most floor(epsilon(n) Q) malformed positions, possibly depending on N and s. The joint state is arbitrary subject to its reduced state on all other positions being exactly rho_s^{tensor (Q-|B|)}. Malformed systems may be correlated or entangled with each other and with other systems subject to that marginal promise. No source control, purification access, or preparation inverse is supplied.
